newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Madonna to come under academic scrutiny.
newsitem.headline: Madonna to come under academic scrutiny.

text.p: Pop star Madonna, one of the world's most gawped-at celebrities, is to come under academic scrutiny.
The University of Amsterdam said on Friday it was starting a study course entitled "Madonna: the music and the phenomenon."
It will run for 10 weeks with four hours of lectures per week and will look at Madonna's work and articles about her controversial career. So far, 63 students have enrolled.

"We think it's high time that pop music is studied. Madonna is the most famous female pop artist of the last 15 years and has expressed interest in many social issues," said one of the course leaders, Mark van den Berg.
Van den Berg, who holds a doctorate in computational linguistics, said Madonna's examinations of racism, sexuality and feminism provided ample material for investigation.
But there were no plans to invite the star to make a personal appearance.
